title: Detection of Breast Cancer Lump and BRCA1/2 Genetic Mutation under Deep Learning.
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习做乳腺肿块图像分割并检测BRCA1/2基因突变，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: To diagnose and cure breast cancer early, thus reducing the mortality of patients with breast cancer, a method was provided to judge threshold of image segmentation by wavelet transform (WT). It was used to obtain information about the general area of breast lumps by making a rough segmentation of the suspected area of the lump on mammogram. The boundary signal of the lump was obtained by region growth calculation or contour model of local activity. Meanwhile, multiplex polymerase chain reaction (mPCR) and mPCR-next-generation sequencing (mPCR-NGS) were used to detect BRCA1/2 genome. Sanger test was used for newly high virulent mutations to verify the correctness of mutagenic sites. The results were compared with the information marked by experts in the database. According to Daubechies wavelet coefficients, the average measurement accuracy was 92.9% and the average false positive rate of each image was 86%. According to mPCR-NGS, there was no pathogenic mutation in the 7 patients with high-risk BRCA1/2 genetic mutations. Single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in nonsynonymous coding region was detected, which was consistent with the Sanger test results. This method effectively isolated the lump area of human mammogram, and mPCR-NGS had high specificity and sensitivity in detecting BRCA1/2 genetic mutation sites. Compared with traditional Sanger test and target sequence capture test, it also had such advantages as easy operation, short duration, and low cost of consumables, which was worthy of further promotion and adoption.
abstract_zh: 为早期诊断和治疗乳腺癌，从而降低乳腺癌患者的死亡率，提出了一种通过小波变换（WT）判断图像分割阈值的方法。该方法用于在乳腺X线照片上对肿块疑似区域进行粗略分割，以获取乳腺肿块的大致区域信息。通过区域生长计算或局部活动轮廓模型获得肿块的边界信号。同时，使用多重聚合酶链反应（mPCR）和mPCR-下一代测序（mPCR-NGS）检测BRCA1/2基因组。对于新发现的高致病性突变，采用Sanger测序验证突变位点的正确性。结果与数据库中专家标记的信息进行了比较。根据Daubechies小波系数，平均测量准确率为92.9%，每张图像的平均假阳性率为86%。根据mPCR-NGS结果，7名具有高风险BRCA1/2基因突变的患者中未发现致病性突变。检测到非同义编码区中的单核苷酸多态性（SNP），与Sanger测序结果一致。该方法有效分离了人体乳腺X线照片中的肿块区域，且mPCR-NGS在检测BRCA1/2基因突变位点方面具有较高的特异性和敏感性。与传统Sanger测序和靶序列捕获测序相比，该方法还具有操作简便、耗时短、耗材成本低等优点，值得进一步推广和应用。
